thread:
maria: FYI deploybot blocked promote for service-proxy. Failure: attestation_signer_untrusted. Tag: release-20260330, digest=sha256:99aabbcc...

deploy-bot: Promote aborted: attestation signer fingerprint not in allowed_signers list for org account. Found signer=fingerprint:3f2a... Allowed: [fingerprint:a12b..., fingerprint:b34c...]. Audit: promote-1812345670.

registry-team: This happened because we rotated cosign signing key in our build account yesterday and the new key is from a cross-account KMS that isn't yet added to the verifier allowlist. The attestation is valid, just signer unknown.

ops: options: 1) add new signer fingerprint to allowlist (requires approval for cross-account trust) 2) retag and re-sign with allowed key 3) manual digest pin override and proceed for canary 4) pause release until allowlist change completes.

release-manager: We need low-risk route. Can we do a canary with manual digest pin and follow up by updating allowlist? Keep audit trail.

maria: manual pin for canary is acceptable, but Dedicated customers expect signed attestations. We'll need to coordinate immediate allowlist update for GA after canary succeeds.

ops: i'll run a manual promote pin: `deploybot promote --repo service-proxy --tag release-20260330 --pin sha256:99aabbcc... --force --reason "untrusted signer; manual pin for canary; follow-up to add key"`

deploy-bot: Promote started (manual override). Pin applied: sha256:99aabbcc.... Canary rollout to 2% us-east-1. Audit note: user=ops, reason="untrusted signer".

cosign-bot: Attestation present and signed by fingerprint:3f2a... (new key). Verification ok except signer not in allowlist.

maria: smoke check: `curl -sS https://canary.service-proxy.redwood.cloud/health | jq .ok` -> true on two pods. Latency within SLO.

release-manager: good. schedule change window 12:00-12:20 PT. I'll add release note: "manual digest pin due to cosign key rotation; no functional changes. New signer key to be added to verifier allowlist after security review."

registry-team: I'll start the allowlist change request. It needs security review and ACL update to verifier config. ETA ~30-45m if approvals quick. Ticket: https://github.com/redwood-inference/security/issues/2040

ops: created a short-lived exception record in audit and flagged Dedicated customers with security contacts. Also queued a backfill task to re-sign affected images with approved key once allowlist updated.

deploy-bot: Promote complete: canary healthy. Override recorded.

release-manager: follow-ups: - security review and allowlist update (security#2040) - backfill resign job (ci#612) - release notes blurb and notify #customers-notify. I'll draft the blurb now.

maria: thanks. closing thread for now. Will reopen if canary alerts. :white_check_mark:
